releaseNotes: Arabic Search Recovery keeps the completed Smart Search index instead of rebuilding it. Arabic content already saved in the index is matched with Arabic-aware folding for Alef variants, Ya/Alef-Maqsura, Ta-Marbuta, tatweel, diacritics, joined or separated spaces such as عبدالرحيم / عبد الرحيم, Arabic-Indic digits, and RTL reversed OCR tokens. English and number search behavior remains unchanged. PaddleOCR Arabic recognition no longer discards lines at the previous 0.28 confidence threshold twice, so newly indexed or changed visual PDFs/images retain more Arabic text. Existing SQLite path/mtime/size checkpoints, Turbo micro-batches, Pause/Resume, Search by Name, Search Content, Connect to PC, Transfer Status, reminders, sounds, and prior Smart Life behavior are preserved.
